properties.name: essentials.json.wire-format-check
properties.description: What to do at startup with a JSONSerializer or JSONEventSerializer bean, backed by a Jackson3JSONSerializer, whose mapper does not write and read the JSON format Essentials persists (typically a replacement bean built on a hand-configured JsonMapper). WARN logs one ERROR banner per deviating bean, FAIL stops the application, OFF skips the check. Spring Boot's web JsonMapper is not checked.
